scope: Press Kit v2 asset candidates for KrisKrug.co
availability_rule: Only entries with status approved may expose public_download_url or be offered as press-kit downloads.

status_definitions.approved: Rights, reuse scope, source, and public download are documented.
status_definitions.candidate: A plausible brand asset that still needs a selection or provenance decision.
status_definitions.blocked-rights: A file exists, but the documented reuse scope does not permit a public press download.
status_definitions.missing: A required variant or source file was not found.

summary.integration_state: No download buttons are safe to render until KK and the relevant creator confirm press-download reuse.

assets.title: Current Aurora Kris Krüg wordmark
assets.owner: Kris Krüg / KrisKrug.co controls this brand asset; authorship of the underlying lettering is not independently recorded.
assets.reuse_terms: Public press download is not yet cleared. KK must confirm editorial-use terms and that the Canva-derived export may be redistributed.
assets.rights_evidence: Commit 8530a10, authored and committed by Kris Krüg, added this Canva-derived file as the official Aurora header wordmark. That proves site use, not a broader redistribution license.
assets.alt: Kris Krüg wordmark in pastel rainbow brush script
notes: Keep as the current visual reference, but source the master vector before offering downloads.
No separate light-background, dark-background, monochrome, or print-ready variant is documented.
The PNG has transparency, but its 468 by 229 raster size is not a durable press master.
